Overview

ServiceNow Solutions & Services

Advisory, implementation, administration and support, integration, and migration — spanning the ServiceNow AI Platform from core ITSM and CSM to AI Agents and Now Assist.

01

AI Agents & Now Assist

Autonomous agents that take action, coordinated by AI Agent Orchestrator and governed through AI Control Tower — plus generative Now Assist copilots for the work that still needs a human in the loop.

02

ServiceNow Otto

Now Assist, Moveworks, and AI Experience, unified into one conversational front door that finishes the work — not just answers it.

03

Customer Service Management (CSM)

Predictive Intelligence classifies incoming cases while Advanced Work Assignment gets them to the right agent instantly — no manual triage between front, middle, and back office.

04

Field Service Management (FSM)

Schedule Optimization keeps the right technician on the right job, while Predictive Intelligence catches equipment failures before they happen.

05

IT Service Management (ITSM)

Predictive Intelligence routes incidents automatically and Now Assist drafts the resolution — turning IT service delivery from reactive to proactive.

06

IT Operations Management (ITOM)

Predictive AIOps catches the anomaly before it becomes an outage, so your team gets a head start instead of a 2am page.

07

HR Service Delivery

Improve employee experience and productivity with Now Assist and AI Agents, and expedite employee onboarding and requests.

08

Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)

Now Assist for SPM keeps portfolio data current automatically, so leadership prioritizes against real business outcomes — not last quarter's spreadsheet.

09

Now Platform

Build Agent turns a plain-language description into a governed, deployable app — no waiting on a dev queue for every small request.

ServiceNow Offerings

Exterprise delivers ServiceNow expertise from onshore, nearshore, and offshore teams worldwide. As a ServiceNow Premier Partner for Consulting & Implementation, our practice spans the full platform — from foundational ITSM and CSM, powered by Predictive Intelligence and Virtual Agent, to the current generation of AI Agents and Now Assist — for clients in Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Government, and Service Provider industries.

ServiceNow's AI, deployed with intent

  • AI Agents that triage, resolve, and escalate work with full case context
  • Now Assist implementation across ITSM, HR Service Delivery, and Creator
  • AI Agent Orchestrator coordinating a multi-agent Autonomous Workforce, so agents hand off work cleanly instead of colliding
  • AI Control Tower and Now Assist Guardian for enterprise-wide AI governance, usage control, and oversight
  • Predictive Intelligence classification and routing underneath ITSM, CSM, and HRSD
  • Process Mining to identify what's worth automating before you build it

Administration & Support

  • ServiceNow platform patch management
  • Monitoring application health and performance, including AI Agent activity through AI Control Tower
  • User & license management and optimization, including Now Assist licensing
  • Security audit and data management
  • Catalog maintenance
  • 24x7 dedicated help desk
  • Coordination with ServiceNow Support
  • CMDB and Discovery maintenance, keeping Service Mapping accurate as infrastructure changes

Implementation

  • Customization of out-of-the-box ServiceNow modules
  • Implementation across the ServiceNow portfolio — ITSM, ITOM, CSM, FSM, HRSD, SPM, and beyond
  • AI Agent and Now Assist deployment and configuration
  • Module-specific AI setup — Predictive Intelligence and Advanced Work Assignment for CSM, Schedule Optimization for FSM, Predictive AIOps for ITOM
  • Custom application development using App Engine and Build Agent on the Now Platform
  • New catalog development and portal customization using the Now Experience UI Builder
  • Configuration of Mid-Servers and ServiceNow Discovery
  • Platform and version upgrades

Integration

  • Integration of IaaS, SaaS, ERP, legacy systems, and social apps via IntegrationHub
  • Identity provider integration for SSO
  • CTI and messaging solution integration
  • AI Agent integration with third-party systems and data sources via IntegrationHub spokes and custom web services
  • Integration across ServiceNow modules and processes via native APIs and Flow Designer actions

Migration

  • Data migration from legacy ticketing applications to ServiceNow
  • Wiki and Knowledge Base migration from cloud-based systems, structured to power AI Search and Now Assist from day one
  • Platform migration from older to newer ServiceNow versions
  • Migrating legacy chatbots and virtual agents onto AI Agents and Now Assist
  • Data mapping templates for migration to and from the ServiceNow platform
